goal.name: Cybersecurity
goal.valid_for: 2026 entry-level SOC / security analyst skills (aligned to ISC2 CC and CompTIA Security+ SY0-701 topics)
goal.video_language_note: English: topic videos from Professor Messer (Security+ SY0-701), Practical Networking, NetworkChuck, Chris Greer, 13Cubed, freeCodeCamp and others. Hindi: full courses from SikhoLive and Shesh Chauhan IT Trainer.
career_outcomes: Understand networks, Linux, Windows and core security concepts
Monitor logs and investigate incidents with a SIEM
Use a vulnerability scanner and manage findings with CVSS
Practise ethical hacking legally in an isolated lab
Build a portfolio and prepare for ISC2 CC / CompTIA Security+ and a SOC Analyst role
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official docs, open-licence books, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted material re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated.

estimated_hours.note: Beginner to job-ready planning estimate. Video minutes are estimates until the link checker fills real durations (+15% rule applied in-app).

goal.safety_policy: This roadmap teaches defensive and ethical security. Every hands-on activity is done only on systems you own (your own isolated home lab) or on platforms that explicitly permit practice, such as TryHackMe, PortSwigger Web Security Academy, OverTheWire and picoCTF. Scanning, accessing or attacking any system without the owner's written permission is illegal in India under the IT Act 2000 (sections 43 and 66). FreeMentor never links tools or instructions aimed at compromising real third-party systems.
